releaseName: Lokify v1.4.5 – In-App Google Sign-In, Direct APK Updater & Lokify.apk Release
releaseNotes:
• In-App Google Account Chooser: Fixed 'The requested action is invalid'. Clean in-app account selection that never navigates away.
• Direct In-App Software Updater: Downloads Lokify.apk in-app and launches the package installer automatically.
• Released as Lokify.apk: Official release artifact packaged as Lokify.apk.
• Clean Production Experience: Zero demo alerts, zero phone prompts, zero leaked credentials.
